spec.name: Arctic Research Outpost
spec.description: A Firewatch-style flat-colour diorama of a snowbound polar research station: a raised main cabin, a radio mast and dish, a weather and instrument yard, and a fuel and vehicle area, all on a small snow plateau.
spec.layout: A low snow plateau (about 6 x 6 m, 0.3 m thick) with gently faceted drifts. The main cabin (red-orange walls, cream trim, dark pitched roof with snow cap) sits left of centre (+X) with its door and a porch facing +Z. A tall lattice radio mast with a dish stands at the back (-Z) near the cabin. The weather yard sits at front right (-X, +Z): a Stevenson screen, an anemometer pole, a sample rack and a flag. Right of the cabin (-X) the fuel and vehicle area holds a snowcat, fuel drums and a generator shed. Flat colour only, with warm sunset oranges against cool blue shadows, thin dark window and door outlines as separate small parts, and glowing yellow windows.

parts.builds: Snow plateau: a faceted wide slab (snow top, snowShade sides, snowDeep base ring), several lumpy drift wedges and low snow mounds against the cabin and edges, a few rock outcrops (rock) poking through, small ice patches (ice), a packed path of snowShade slabs from the cabin door toward the yard, and footprints as tiny dark flat parts. Stays simple, sized to the other pieces.
parts.attaches: Top surface at groundTop (y=0.3); all other parts rest on it.

parts.builds: The hero: a boxy cabin 3.0 x 2.0 x 2.4 m on short wood stilts/skids, cabinRed walls with horizontal plank lines (cabinDark thin strips), trimCream corner posts, window frames and door frame, outlined windows with windowGlow panes and mullions, a door with handle, a porch with steps, railing and a lamp (lampGlow), a pitched roof of roofDark slabs with a snow cap on top and snow lumps along the eaves, icicles (ice) along the front eave, a steel chimney with a smoke-free cap, a stack of wood logs beside the wall, a hanging orange life ring and a small sign board with a simple emblem on the front.
parts.attaches: Floor at cabinFloor; door at cabinDoor; roof ridge at roofRidge; the back wall faces the mast near mastBase.

parts.builds: Tall lattice radio mast 3.9 m: three tapering steel legs with cross braces and diagonal rods (steel, steelDark), concrete-like base plinth (rock) with guy wires (thin rods) anchored to snow with small stakes, a platform ring near the top with orange and white banded segments, antennas whip rods, a red blinking beacon light (flagRed, glowing) on top, and a parabolic satellite dish (lathe dome in trimCream with steelDark arm and feed horn) at dishMount aimed forward and up. Also a small equipment box on the plinth with outlined door and cables.
parts.attaches: Base at mastBase on the terrain; dish at dishMount; sits behind the cabin.

parts.builds: The instrument yard at front left: a white Stevenson screen (trimCream, louvre strips, wood legs), an anemometer on a pole (three cups, vane) in orange, a rain and snow gauge cylinder, a wooden sample rack holding ice-core tubes (ice, steel caps), a flagpole with a flagRed flag and a trimCream stripe, a solar panel on a tilted stand (drumBlue with grid lines), a small snow-stake measuring pole with orange bands, and a couple of storage crates (wood, woodLight bands, outline label marks).
parts.attaches: Centred on yardCenter; rests on terrain; path leads toward cabinDoor.

parts.builds: Vehicle and fuel area at back left: a yellowCat snowcat with a boxy cab, tracks (rubber, with tread bars and steel roller wheels), glowing headlights, outlined cab windows with windowGlow, roof rack with a jerrycan and antenna, orange stripe and front blade in steelDark; a rack of fuel drums (drumBlue, drumGreen, orange) with band rings, lids and bungs, tipped with snow caps; a small generator shed (steel walls, roofDark roof, vent grille, exhaust pipe, outline door, small lamp) with hoses and cables running to the cabin; a sled with a tarp load behind the snowcat.
parts.attaches: Centred on fuelArea; rests on terrain; cable from shed runs toward the cabin side wall.
